notes.title: New Languages added!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
I'm excited to announce that I've added three new languages to the game: French, German, and Russian! The translation process took longer than I expected due to various challenges.
I partially created the content using an AI trained on our game's specific data. While I believe the translation quality is good, I know there might be room for improvement. I've created a dedicated forum thread where you can report any translation issues you encounter.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Chinese Language Added to the game.
notes.content:
Release Notes v4.2.0.10

[b]New Features:[/b]
1. Chinese Language Support
   - Full game now available in Chinese

[b]2. Language Selection Prompt[/b]
   - Game now asks for preferred language at start if system language is not English

[b]3. Expanded Guide Languages[/b]
   - Added Spanish and Chinese to the in-game Guide

Developer Notes:
I've done my best to thoroughly test these changes, and your saved games should continue working fine. However, if you encounter any issues, please report them on our forum.

Thank you for your continued support and enjoy the new language options!

notes.title: Pleasure Thieves: The Guide & Extras
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I've finally fixed the issues with the DLC—sorry for the trouble! If you need help unlocking all achievements or photos from the album, you can follow the English guide to get them all. I tested everything as thoroughly as possible, but if you come across any problems, please let me know in the discussion board thread, and I'll do my best to fix them.

Just a [b]reminder[/b]: the extra story content for Ms. Evans and Elisabeth is already included and available for everyone in the main game.

You can find the Extras folder within the Main game folder.
[i]"Pleasure Thieves Extras"[/i]
